HYDROPOWER FOR INDUSTRY

Discover how the power of moving water can support industrial production with reliable, low-carbon electricity.

HYDROPOWER: POWERING INDUSTRY RESPONSIBLY

A short brochure • Six key points

1Hydropower generates electricity by using flowing or falling water to turn turbines.
2It can provide dependable electricity for factories and large industrial facilities.
3Industries such as manufacturing, mining, metals, chemicals and food processing use electricity generated from hydropower.
4During operation, hydropower produces very low direct greenhouse-gas emissions.
5Its output can be adjusted in many power systems to help balance electricity demand.
6Responsible planning is essential to reduce impacts on rivers, wildlife and nearby communities.
THE BIG IDEA
Hydropower can help industry move toward a more reliable and sustainable energy future when projects are carefully designed and managed.
